title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_wahllos_by_jeffery_deaver_bjdsm (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_wahllos_by_jeffery_deaver_bjdsm' contains malicious code that fully compromises any computer on which it is installed or running. The compromise is severe enough that all secrets and keys stored on the affected system should be rotated immediately from a different, secure machine. Removing the package alone may not eliminate all malicious software introduced by its installation.
